projects.name: ShellBench
projects.title: ShellBench: Whole-Building Embodied Carbon of Thin-Shell Floors
projects.status: Week 1 complete. Anchor model built and checked, shell floor work started, first release v0.0.1.
bullets: **Research Problem:** How significantly do funicular concrete shell floors reduce A1-A3 embodied carbon in code-designed RC frame structures across 3–8 storeys when strict diaphragm action, perimeter ties, and seismic chord demands are enforced?
**Validation Baseline:** Audited my hand-calculated thesis frame building and turned its results into automated verification targets.

**Verification Pipeline:** Automated suite of 132 continuous integration tests checking internal moments, shear distributions, and lateral drift limits under gravity, wind, and response-spectrum seismic excitation.
**Planned:** Pre-registered parametric sweep over ground accelerations (0.05-0.40 g), a Zenodo DOI from v0.1, and machine-learning surrogate models.

projects.name: ShellForm
projects.title: ShellForm: Seismic Resilience vs. Carbon Cost in Form-Found Shells
projects.status: Pre-registration approved 30 Oct 2026. One shell analysed in CalculiX (static, modal, buckling), 31 tests, both form-finding strategies implemented and tested.
bullets: **Research Problem:** Measures the direct embodied-carbon consequence of making form-found shell geometries earthquake-resistant, extending the seismic form-finding methods of Michiels & Adriaenssens (2017–2018) with standardized carbon accounting (GB/T 51366 and ICE inventory).
**Computational Scope:** Parametric matrix of 168 sized shells defined across support topologies, rise-to-span ratios, and ground acceleration ranges (0-0.6 g). Runs are planned.
**Deliverables:** Open-access interactive Three.js design space explorer, in development.

projects.name: Canopy
projects.title: Parametric Aviation-Terminal Canopy Optimization
bullets: Live web prototype linking canopy curvature to real-time structural proxy metrics and A1-A3 embodied carbon estimates. A simplified, screening-level research demo.

projects.name: Nano-WMA
projects.title: Nano-Modified Warm-Mix Asphalt: Durability & Life-Cycle Assessment
bullets: Built an object-oriented Python engine linking empirical moisture-damage laboratory metrics (Tensile Strength Ratio) with climate-driven weathering models.
Comparative cradle-to-gate LCA found a 5.2% production GWP decrease (61.31 to 58.15 kg CO2e/t). With a 15% service-life extension, annualized lifecycle GWP falls by **17.5%**.
